bugs.name: Orders channel-settings navigation jumps back to the setup wizard
bugs.summary: Clicking Orders in the channel settings navigation repeatedly jumps back to the setup wizard instead of showing Orders settings.
bugs.expected: Clicking Orders in the channel settings navigation should bring the Orders settings into view so they can be inspected or changed.
bugs.actual: On two attempts, clicking Orders from the visible channel settings navigation returned the page to the top setup wizard; the Orders settings were not shown. The wizard remained visible after the page settled.
reproSteps: Using the authenticated administrator session loaded for this run (no username or password was entered), open /configuration/.
Open the Channels card under Markets & channels.
Create a fresh channel named markets-a7c9 with Canada as its default country and CAD as its currency. Do not assign a warehouse or shipping zone.
On /channels/Q2hhbm5lbDo4?action=setup, scroll until the channel settings navigation and General settings card are visible.
Click Orders in the left channel settings navigation. Observe the page jump to the top setup wizard instead of showing Orders settings.
Scroll back to the channel settings navigation and click Orders again. The page again jumps to the setup wizard and remains there after settling.
bugs.reason: On a fresh Canada/CAD channel without stock or shipping assignments, Orders navigation repeatedly brings the Orders settings into view, including at the specified action=setup URL.

bugs.name: Channel warehouse order remains reversed after Save completes or reload
bugs.summary: Claims warehouse priority persists in the wrong order, or the UI remains wrong beyond the brief saving-state flash.
bugs.expected: Once Save has fully completed, the chosen Americas–Europe priority should remain visible and persist after reload.
bugs.actual: Rejected claim: after saving finishes and the page settles, the order remains Europe–Americas, or reloading retains that reversed priority. A quick flip-flop confined to the saving state does not establish this lasting-UI or persistence claim.
reproSteps: Sign in to the supplied Saleor Dashboard fixture through the normal UI with the authorized fixture account and open Configuration > Channels.
Create a uniquely named disposable channel with a unique slug, select United States of America and USD from the actual country and currency options, and open its detail page.

In Inventory, choose Assign. Check Americas first, then search for and check Europe. Confirm the two assignments and verify the displayed order is Americas then Europe with Follow the list order selected.
Click Save without dragging or otherwise reordering warehouses. Observe the warehouse rows throughout the brief saving state, rather than inspecting only a later settled screenshot.
Wait until Save has fully completed and the page has settled; verify Americas then Europe. Reload and verify the same intended order.
bugs.reason: The user explicitly rejected persistence failure and lasting wrong UI order beyond the quick save-state flash. Independent checks preserved Americas then Europe after full Save completion, after later waits, and after reload. The save pipeline separately persists the intended priority through a reorder mutation. This rejection must not match the accepted severity-1 transient flash during the saving state.

matchingGuidance.rejectionScope: Wrong priority that remains after Save fully completes and the page settles, including any claim that it is persisted across reload. Excludes the accepted brief saving-state visual flash.
